texts.facts: The instant application has been filed for the following main relief:- "Wherefore it is most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to quash the entire proceedings including Chalani Report dated 11.8.2024 filed by Sub-Inspector of police of Thakurganj, in Case No. 1468/2024, U/S 126/135 B.N.S.S. as well as impugned order dated 27.8.2024 U/S-130 B.N.S.S. passed by Additional Police Commissioner/Executive Magistrate, Chowk, Police Commissionerate Lucknow, in respect of aforesaid case in the interest of Justice." Vaibhav Singh vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 18 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49754098/ 1 3. It is stated that on account of apprehension that the applicant may cause breach of peace, a report was submitted by the S.H.O., Police Station- Thakurganj , District- Lucknow in the light of provisions indicated under Section 126/135 of BNSS. 4.
texts.arguments: In this respect, learned counsel for the revisionist has relied on 2010 (2) JIC 36 (All) (LB) Rakesh Singh @ Rakesh Kumar Singh vs. State of UP.
